(function() {
    if (window.emreSniperActive) {
        console.log('EmreSniper already running!');
        return;
    }
    window.emreSniperActive = true;

    let intervalId = null;
    let clickCount = 0;
    let audioCtx = null;
    let alarmTimer = null;
    let isRunning = false;
    let dismissObserver = null;

    function getAudioCtx() {
        if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
        return audioCtx;
    }

    function beep(freq, duration, type, volume, delay) {
        const ctx = getAudioCtx();
        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = ctx.createGain();
        osc.type = type;
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime + delay);
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, ctx.currentTime + delay);
        gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(volume, ctx.currentTime + delay + 0.02);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + delay + duration);
        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(ctx.destination);
        osc.start(ctx.currentTime + delay);
        osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + delay + duration + 0.05);
    }

    function playStartSound() {
        beep(523.25, 0.12, 'sine', 0.3, 0);
        beep(659.25, 0.12, 'sine', 0.3, 0.15);
        beep(783.99, 0.2, 'sine', 0.3, 0.3);
    }

    function playStopSound() {
        beep(659.25, 0.12, 'sine', 0.3, 0);
        beep(523.25, 0.12, 'sine', 0.3, 0.15);
        beep(392.0, 0.2, 'sine', 0.3, 0.3);
    }

    function playAlarm() {
        if (alarmTimer) {
            clearTimeout(alarmTimer);
            alarmTimer = null;
        }
        for (let t = 0; t < 5000; t += 250) {
            beep(880, 0.2, 'square', 0.25, t / 1000);
            beep(1174.66, 0.2, 'square', 0.25, t / 1000 + 0.125);
        }
        alarmTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            alarmTimer = null;
        }, 5000);
    }

    function dismissQueueMessages() {
        if (!isRunning) return false;

        const visible = (el) => {
            const style = getComputedStyle(el);
            const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
            return (
                style.display !== 'none' &&
                style.visibility !== 'hidden' &&
                rect.width > 0 &&
                rect.height > 0
            );
        };

        const clickDismiss = (el) => {
            const btn = el.closest('button, [role="button"], a') || el;
            btn.click();
            return true;
        };

        const ariaButtons = document.querySelectorAll('[aria-label="Dismiss message"]');
        for (const el of ariaButtons) {
            if (visible(el)) return clickDismiss(el);
        }

        const allButtons = document.querySelectorAll('button, [role="button"], a');
        for (const el of allButtons) {
            if (el.textContent.trim() === 'Dismiss message' && visible(el)) {
                return clickDismiss(el);
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    function startDismissWatcher() {
        stopDismissWatcher();

        dismissObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
            if (isRunning) dismissQueueMessages();
        });
        dismissObserver.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });

        dismissQueueMessages();
    }

    function stopDismissWatcher() {
        if (dismissObserver) {
            dismissObserver.disconnect();
            dismissObserver = null;
        }
    }

    function makeDraggable(handle, target) {
        let dragging = false;
        let startX = 0;
        let startY = 0;
        let offsetX = 0;
        let offsetY = 0;
        let pendingX = 0;
        let pendingY = 0;
        let frame = null;

        handle.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
            if (e.button !== 0) return;
            if (e.target.closest('.es-close-btn')) return;

            dragging = true;
            startX = e.clientX;
            startY = e.clientY;
            handle.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
            e.preventDefault();
        });

        handle.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
            if (!dragging) return;

            pendingX = offsetX + (e.clientX - startX);
            pendingY = offsetY + (e.clientY - startY);

            if (!frame) {
                frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    frame = null;
                    target.style.transform = `translate(${pendingX}px, ${pendingY}px)`;
                });
            }
        });

        const stopDrag = (e) => {
            if (!dragging) return;

            dragging = false;
            offsetX = pendingX;
            offsetY = pendingY;

            if (frame) {
                cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
                frame = null;
            }
        };

        handle.addEventListener('pointerup', stopDrag);
        handle.addEventListener('pointercancel', stopDrag);

        const reset = () => {
            dragging = false;
            offsetX = 0;
            offsetY = 0;
            pendingX = 0;
            pendingY = 0;

            if (frame) {
                cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
                frame = null;
            }

            target.style.transform = '';
        };

        return { reset };
    }

    const style = document.createElement('style');
    style.textContent = `
        @keyframes emreSlideIn {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-20px) scale(0.95); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
        }

        @keyframes emreShift {
            0% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
            50% { background-position: 100% 50%; }
            100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
        }

        @keyframes emreGlow {
            0%, 100% {
                box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(255, 92, 138, 0.55), 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
            }
            50% {
                box-shadow: 0 0 45px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.65), 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
            }
        }

        @keyframes emreOrb {
            0% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }
            50% { transform: translate(-30px, 40px) scale(1.2); }
            100% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }
        }

        @keyframes emreShine {
            0% { transform: translateX(-150%) skewX(-20deg); }
            100% { transform: translateX(250%) skewX(-20deg); }
        }

        @keyframes emreStatusPulse {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
            50% { opacity: 0.5; }
        }

        .es-container {
            position: fixed;
            top: 80px;
            right: 30px;
            width: 360px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e0b2d, #3b1d5e, #2d0f4a);
            background-size: 400% 400%;
            animation:
                emreSlideIn 0.35s ease,
                emreShift 10s ease infinite,
                emreGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite;
            border-radius: 18px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
            z-index: 9999999;
            font-family: 'gg sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
            overflow: hidden;
            color: #e8eaf0;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            will-change: transform;
        }

        .es-container::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            width: 220px;
            height: 220px;
            top: -80px;
            right: -60px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 92, 138, 0.35), transparent 70%);
            border-radius: 50%;
            pointer-events: none;
            animation: emreOrb 8s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        .es-container::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            width: 180px;
            height: 180px;
            bottom: -60px;
            left: -60px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25), transparent 70%);
            border-radius: 50%;
            pointer-events: none;
            animation: emreOrb 10s ease-in-out infinite reverse;
        }

        .es-header {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff5c8a, #ffffff, #a855f7);
            background-size: 200% 200%;
            animation: emreShift 6s ease infinite;
            color: white;
            padding: 16px 18px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            cursor: grab;
            touch-action: none;
            user-select: none;
            -webkit-user-drag: none;
        }

        .es-header:active {
            cursor: grabbing;
        }

        .es-header::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 40%;
            height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25), transparent);
            animation: emreShine 3.5s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        .es-header h2 {
            margin: 0;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            text-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
        }

        .es-header p {
            margin: 2px 0 0;
            font-size: 11px;
            opacity: 0.9;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .es-logo {
            width: 52px;
            height: 52px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: white;
            object-fit: cover;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
            box-shadow:
                0 0 0 3px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.6),
                0 0 18px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.9);
        }

        .es-close-btn {
            position: absolute;
            top: 10px;
            right: 12px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
            border: none;
            color: white;
            font-size: 16px;
            cursor: pointer;
            line-height: 1;
            width: 26px;
            height: 26px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            transition: 0.2s;
        }

        .es-close-btn:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 92, 138, 0.85);
            transform: rotate(90deg);
        }

        .es-body {
            padding: 16px;
            background: rgba(20, 18, 40, 0.55);
            position: relative;
        }

        .es-status-row,
        .es-clicks-row {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 10px 14px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            transition: 0.2s;
        }

        .es-status-row:hover,
        .es-clicks-row:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
        }

        .es-status-row strong,
        .es-clicks-row strong {
            font-size: 11px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            color: #b5bac1;
        }

        .es-status-running {
            color: #a855f7;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.8);
            animation: emreStatusPulse 1s infinite;
        }

        .es-status-stopped {
            color: #ff5c8a;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .es-clicks-count {
            font-size: 20px;
            font-weight: 800;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff5c8a, #a855f7);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        }

        .es-input-group {
            margin-bottom: 14px;
        }

        .es-input-group label {
            display: block;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: #b5bac1;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .es-input {
            width: 100%;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            padding: 10px 14px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
            color: #e8eaf0;
            font-size: 14px;
            outline: none;
            transition: 0.2s;
        }

        .es-input:focus {
            border-color: #ff5c8a;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255, 92, 138, 0.4);
        }

        .es-toggle {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            padding: 10px 14px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border-radius: 12px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 13px;
            color: #e8eaf0;
            user-select: none;
            transition: 0.2s;
        }

        .es-toggle:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.5);
        }

        .es-toggle input {
            display: none;
        }

        .es-toggle-switch {
            width: 40px;
            height: 22px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
            border-radius: 11px;
            position: relative;
            transition: 0.2s;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .es-toggle-switch::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            top: 2px;
            left: 2px;
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
            background: white;
            border-radius: 50%;
            transition: 0.2s;
        }

        .es-toggle input:checked + .es-toggle-switch {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff5c8a, #a855f7);
        }

        .es-toggle input:checked + .es-toggle-switch::after {
            left: 20px;
        }

        .es-btn-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .es-button {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 11px 0;
            border-radius: 12px;
            border: none;
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 14px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: 0.2s;
            color: white;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }

        .es-button:disabled {
            opacity: 0.35;
            cursor: not-allowed;
        }

        .es-start {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #a855f7, #ff5c8a);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.5);
        }
        .es-start:hover:not(:disabled) {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 22px rgba(255, 92, 138, 0.7);
        }

        .es-stop {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff5c8a, #a855f7);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(255, 92, 138, 0.5);
        }
        .es-stop:hover:not(:disabled) {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 22px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.7);
        }

        .es-reset {
            margin-top: 10px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
            color: #e8eaf0;
            box-shadow: none;
        }
        .es-reset:hover:not(:disabled) {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
            border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.5);
        }

        .es-footer {
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 10px;
            padding: 9px;
            color: #9da3b0;
            background: rgba(10, 8, 25, 0.6);
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
            letter-spacing: 2px;
        }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(style);

    const container = document.createElement('div');
    container.className = 'es-container';
    container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="es-header">
            <img class="es-logo" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="logo">
            <div>
                <h2>EmreSniper 🎀</h2>
                <p>🌸 Made by EmreStar</p>
            </div>
            <button class="es-close-btn" id="es-close-main">✕</button>
        </div>

        <div class="es-body">
            <div class="es-status-row">
                <strong>🎀 Status</strong>
                <span id="es-status" class="es-status-stopped">Stopped</span>
            </div>

            <div class="es-clicks-row">
                <strong>🍓 Total Joins</strong>
                <span id="es-clicks" class="es-clicks-count">0</span>
            </div>

            <div class="es-input-group">
                <label for="es-interval">🌸 Interval (ms)</label>
                <input class="es-input" id="es-interval" type="number" value="1" min="1">
            </div>

            <label class="es-toggle">
                <input type="checkbox" id="es-dismiss">
                <span class="es-toggle-switch"></span>
                🌟 Auto Dismiss Messages
            </label>

            <div class="es-btn-row">
                <button class="es-button es-start" id="es-start">🌸 Start</button>
                <button class="es-button es-stop" id="es-stop" disabled>💗 Stop</button>
            </div>

            <div class="es-btn-row">
                <button class="es-button es-reset" id="es-reset">💫 Original Position</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="es-footer">
            💗 Emre Sniper 🌷
        </div>
    `;
    document.body.appendChild(container);

    const draggable = makeDraggable(container.querySelector('.es-header'), container);

    container.addEventListener('animationend', function removeEntrance(e) {
        if (e.animationName === 'emreSlideIn') {
            container.style.animation = 'emreShift 10s ease infinite, emreGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite';
        }
    });

    const startBtn = document.getElementById('es-start');
    const stopBtn = document.getElementById('es-stop');
    const resetBtn = document.getElementById('es-reset');
    const closeBtn = document.getElementById('es-close-main');
    const status = document.getElementById('es-status');
    const clicks = document.getElementById('es-clicks');
    const intervalInput = document.getElementById('es-interval');
    const dismissToggle = document.getElementById('es-dismiss');

    dismissToggle.onchange = () => {
        if (dismissToggle.checked && isRunning) {
            startDismissWatcher();
        } else {
            stopDismissWatcher();
        }
    };

    function clickButton() {
        const queueButton = Array.from(document.getElementsByTagName('button'))
            .find(function(btn) {
                return btn.textContent === 'Join Queue';
            });
        if (!queueButton) return;
        queueButton.click();
        clickCount += 1;
        clicks.textContent = clickCount;
        playAlarm();
    }

    startBtn.onclick = () => {
        playStartSound();
        intervalId = setInterval(clickButton, parseInt(intervalInput.value) || 1);
        isRunning = true;
        if (dismissToggle.checked) startDismissWatcher();
        status.textContent = "Running";
        status.className = "es-status-running";
        startBtn.disabled = true;
        stopBtn.disabled = false;
    };

    stopBtn.onclick = () => {
        playStopSound();
        clearInterval(intervalId);
        intervalId = null;
        isRunning = false;
        stopDismissWatcher();
        status.textContent = "Stopped";
        status.className = "es-status-stopped";
        startBtn.disabled = false;
        stopBtn.disabled = true;
    };

    closeBtn.onclick = () => {
        if (intervalId) clearInterval(intervalId);
        if (alarmTimer) clearTimeout(alarmTimer);
        stopDismissWatcher();
        container.remove();
        window.emreSniperActive = false;
        console.log("EmreSniper unloaded (ó﹏ò｡)");
    };

    resetBtn.onclick = () => {
        draggable.reset();
    };

    console.log("💕 EmreSniper Loaded!");
})();
